# SoraDropdownMenu

A menu of actions (or links) opened from a button.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | overlays |
| Import | `import { SoraDropdownMenu } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraDropdownMenu from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraDropdownMenu'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/overlays/SoraDropdownMenu.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/overlays/SoraDropdownMenu.vue) |
| Generic | `T extends SoraMenuItem` |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` **(required)** | `readonly (TItem \| SoraMenuGroup<TItem>)[]` |  | Items, or groups of items. |
| `triggerLabel` | `string` |  | Text of the built-in trigger button. Use the `trigger` slot for richer content. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the menu. Defaults to the trigger's text. |
| `placement` | `SoraPlacement` | `'bottom-start'` | Preferred position relative to the trigger. It flips when there is no room. |
| `variant` | `SoraVariant` | `'outline'` | Appearance of the built-in trigger. |
| `color` | `SoraColor` | `'neutral'` | Colour role. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `size` | `SoraSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control, with the native `disabled` attribute where the element has one. |

## Models

| v-model | Type |  | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model:open` | `boolean` | default `false` | Whether it is open. Stays in sync with the native element, however it was opened or closed. |

| Event | Payload | Description |

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` | `props: { open: boolean }` | Content of the library-owned trigger button. |
| `custom-trigger` | `props: SoraTriggerBindings` | A fully custom trigger: bind `attrs`, `on` and `ref` on its native element. |
| `item` | `props: { item: T }` | Content of one item (the label by default). |

## Exposed

Available on a template ref of the component.

| Member | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | method |  |
| `close` | method |  |

## Attributes

The built-in trigger button. With a custom trigger, bind `attrs`/`on`/`ref` yourself.

## Keyboard

- Enter, Space or Arrow Down on the trigger opens the menu on the first item; Arrow Up on the last.
- Arrow Up/Down move (wrapping); Home/End jump; typing characters jumps to a matching item.
- Enter or Space activates the item and closes the menu.
- Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger; Tab closes and moves on.

## Accessibility

- APG menu button: the trigger has `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded`; items are `role="menuitem"` in `role="menu"`.
- Disabled items stay focusable (`aria-disabled`) but cannot be activated.
- For actions and in-app commands only: ordinary site navigation should be links, not a menu.

## Styling

- `.sora-popover.sora-menu`, `.sora-menu__item`, `.sora-menu__label`, `.sora-menu__separator`
- `data-placement`, item `data-color`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/OverlaysDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/OverlaysDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
  <SoraDropdownMenu
    :items="menu"
    :trigger-label="t('demo.menu.trigger')"
    data-testid="menu-trigger"
    @select="lastAction = $event.id"
  />
  <span class="text-sora-sm text-sora-muted" data-testid="menu-result">{{
    t('demo.selected', { value: lastAction || '—' })
  }}</span>
</div>
```
